limitations: DEMO FIXTURE decision: synthetic values, not a scientific result.
Terrain elevation only: soil/regolith properties, temperature, illumination, water/ice, biology, gravity, radiation, atmosphere, site access and permits are not established by this analysis.
Statistics are computed at 1000 m resolution over 20 km windows; small obstacles, rocks and metre-scale slopes are not represented.
Result is the closest available window within a limited corpus of 3 Earth parent regions, not a global best analog and not a safe-route or landing assessment.
Heuristic terrain similarity index; not a probability and not field validation.
Kilometre-scale (1000 m) regional terrain statistics only; not obstacle, rock or soil-scale roughness.
Terrain data do not establish gravity, vacuum/atmosphere, radiation, temperature, illumination, regolith properties or ice.
Regional terrain reference at ~463 m native / 1000 m analysis scale; not a landing-safety or rover-navigation product.
Center is a planning seed, not a validated scientific claim.
Closest available window within a limited 3-parent corpus, not a global best or validated analog.
Kilometre-scale (1000 m) terrain statistics only; local variation is not rock/grain roughness.
Overlapping windows are correlated samples, not independent observations.
Soil, temperature, biology, gravity, radiation, access and permits are not established by terrain data.
Not a rover-safe route or landing-safety assessment; field suitability is unknown.

proposed_test.title: Regional terrain-planning diversity comparison
proposed_test.summary: Proposed, not executed: run the same traverse-planning and scheduling exercise in the selected window and in the alternative, and compare how the kilometre-scale slope distribution, relief and local height variation change the plans relative to the reference.
steps: Confirm access, permits and safety for the selected window.
Survey metre-scale slopes and obstacles on site; the 1000 m analysis cannot see them.
Run identical planning exercises in both windows and record the differences.
